about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of cowboys overcharging my neighbours.
about_para_1: South Benfleet Plumbing and Locks Services was founded over 12 years ago by a frustrated homeowner fed up with poor service and inflated prices. Today, we're the go-to emergency plumber and locksmith for Basildon and surrounding areas. Our team is Gas Safe registered, fully insured, and trained to handle everything from a simple tap washer to a complete heating system overhaul.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on turning up on time, doing the job properly, and charging what we actually quoted. Repeat customers are the backbone of our business—families who've used us once and trust us enough to recommend us to friends and neighbours. We don't cut corners, and we don't overcharge.
reviews_heading: What Basildon Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to a burst pipe at 2am on a Sunday. Called South Benfleet and they were at my door by 2:45. Turned off the water, capped the leak, and had me sorted with no panic. Wouldn't have known what to do without them. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Got locked out of my flat after work. Phoned them on a Friday evening and the locksmith was with me in 35 minutes. Very professional, didn't damage anything, and the price was fair. No hidden charges. Will use again if needed.
reviews.author: Rachel M.

reviews.text: Had them in for a full boiler service and an odd noise in the radiators. They flushed the whole system, fitted a new valve, and explained what they were doing throughout. No surprise bill at the end either. Honest traders—hard to find these days.
reviews.author: Michael P.
